title: Genesis Approval Requested Event
description: A client's desk asked the client to approve an action, and the approval card was put in front of them. Raised the moment the proposal exists, so the operator and any other consumer can see it without waiting for the client. See bloodbank/docs/event-naming.md (genesis).
$comment: No access keys, tickets, tokens, sealed grants or operator notes in data, and never a full message body: body_preview is the most it carries.

correlationid.description: UUID, the base envelope requires one. uuid5(NAMESPACE_URL, 'urn:33god:genesis:approval:<data.approval_id>'), so every fact of one approval shares it.

ordering_key.description: §11.1 bucket approval:<approval_id>: the request and its outcome, in order.

client_id.description: The client the fact is about.

client_name.description: The client's display name, as the operator sees it. Runtime data only.

bot_id.description: The desk that caused the fact, '<client_id>:<role>', or 'genesis' when the front desk raised it.

summary.description: One line a notification can show as-is.

operator_url.description: Operator surface page for this client.

test.description: True on synthetic events from test clients; consumers label them.

approval_id.description: The proposal id (prop-...). The envelope correlationid is derived from it.

kind.description: What kind of action is awaiting approval, e.g. email.send.

question.description: What the client is asked to approve, with the desk's stated reason.

channel.description: Where the client sees the approval card, e.g. web or telegram.

action.description: The proposed action. Open: fields depend on data.kind. For email.send: to, cc, subject, body_preview.

body_preview.description: Opening of the body, never the whole body (email.send).
